status: executable completion predicate; full-game optimality unproved

objective.criterion: minimize expected elapsed time to completion

user_confirmed_scope.sugar_time_gates: The user authorized narrow long-sugar exceptions. The named profile is the audit interpretation of that instruction, not an individually approved list.
user_confirmed_scope.timing_chosen_to_change_seeded_outcomes: forbidden, including harvest timestamps selected using the publicly exported seed
user_confirmed_scope.scheduled_maintenance_reloads: allowed, preserving native current-save and reload effects; stale restoration remains forbidden
user_confirmed_scope.native_current_save_export_inspection: allowed, including decoding the visible current save and startup seed; no import, editing, rollback, or retry

acquisition_semantics.toggles: currently unlocked or bought, or evidenced earlier access under the same game version and edition
acquisition_semantics.garden_seeds: currently unlocked, including rebuilding after required sacrifice
acquisition_semantics.terminal_run: normal mode, no ascension or reincarnation transition
acquisition_semantics.unbounded_counts: No maximum building amount, level, stock holding, or broker count is required solely because the quantity can grow.

remaining_proof_obligations: Complete and audit every legal action, including UI interactions and the environmental assumptions.
Specify the exact probability law and observation model, including source-seeded PRNG operations.
Prove that the installed JavaScript transitions, numeric operations, timers and adapter refine the Lean model.
Construct a legal policy that reaches the full terminal set from a new save, and determine its expected elapsed time.
Construct a matching lower bound against every admissible policy, including unbounded waits and non-completing paths.
Prove time progress and the connection from accumulated action cost to actual completion time.
Prove that the mod implements the attaining policy.

forbidden: deliberate native UI manipulation of random outcomes
timing chosen to change seeded outcomes
admissible_policy_boundary.diagnostics: Synthetic engine fixtures can examine forbidden behavior; they do not count as admissible strategies.
admissible_policy_boundary.unresolved: The IID53 law, native seeded algorithms, unbounded monotone clock, export permission and ban on timing chosen to change seeded outcomes are fixed. The last restriction applies to decision rules, not just observed traces. Complete observation/action semantics and formal transition refinement remain to be proved.
